name: week
title: Inspection review week
subtitle: Fictional demo or your own records. A dated snapshot, not a live application.

sections.title: Ready for review
sections.sql: select code,project,title,due_on,current_evidence,critical_actions from inspection_review where review_state='needs review' order by due_on,code

sections.title: Overdue actions
sections.sql: select code,inspection,title,severity,owner,days_overdue,state from action_register where state<>'verified' and days_overdue>0 order by days_overdue desc,code

sections.title: Coverage
sections.sql: select * from project_coverage order by code

sections.title: Repeated defects
sections.sql: select i.asset,f.defect_type,count(distinct i.id)::int as inspections,count(*)::int as findings from findings f join inspections i on i.id=f.inspection_id group by i.asset,f.defect_type having count(distinct i.id)>1 order by i.asset,f.defect_type

sections.title: Locations to check
sections.sql: select code,title,asset from inspections where latitude is null order by code

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,current_evidence from inspection_review where current_evidence=0 order by code

sections.title: Stale reviews
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,reviewed_revision from inspections where reviewed_revision is not null and reviewed_revision<>revision order by code

sections.title: Policy reminders
sections.sql: select * from compliance_flags order by record,rule
sections.note: Record checks only. These do not certify safety or legal compliance.
